title: 第21章 直通学校奖励三更求月票第22章 精英合约
content_zh:
;;
“保送名单没我，实战考核名单也没我？”方羽一时间心也有点乱。
若只是保送名单上没有，方羽还勉强能接受，毕竟才十个名额，自己少虚空星相的分数，有先天劣势。
但连实战考核都没进？不正常。
“王墨竟进考核名单了？”
“那个富二代也能进名单？果然是有钱人练武，步步高升，倒是他旁边那个方羽，连实战考核都没进？退步这么大吗？”
“他好像一直没觉醒虚空星相，没入选也正常，技艺高一点，在我们这个阶段优势不大。”
“倒也是。”
“张涛真厉害，竟然冲到了第一。”众多考核者都在闲聊议论着，最受瞩目的，自然是保送名单中排名第一的‘张涛’。
排名第一，说明考核分数也是第一。
这时。
“安静。”穿着宽松武道服的女老师站了出来，她目光如炬扫过大厅，迅速令所有人都安静下来：“名单已出，会公示两日，如果有怀疑自己成绩的，可以在明晚十二点前在官网上申请复核。”
“参加实战考核的70名同学，接下来在校正常修炼，做好准备，实战考核要求的细则会发到你们个人邮箱，9.14号集合。”
“10位保送同学，现在随我上楼，签署文件。”女老师说到这里停顿了下，目光落在方羽身上：“方羽同学，你拿到了直通生名额，不占保送名额，也先跟我来，等会再带你去见湖广武大的几位老师。”
哗~
一片哗然。
刹那间，几乎所有学生目光都集中在了方羽身上，眼神中几乎都透着震惊、难以置信。
“直通生名额？我靠，老方，你深藏不露啊。”王墨激动道。
方羽也有些晕乎乎。
直通生名额？这完全出乎他的预料。

武道大专中想专升本，实际上有三种路径，一种是保送，一种是实战考核选拔，这是最常见的两种。
固定时间、固定考核项目、固定录取人数。
还有一种路径，就是‘直通’。
不限时间年龄……只要在大专中表现出足够的武道天赋，即可直接申请进行考核，考核通过即可进入武道本科，理论上大一就能晋升。
只是，太过罕见。
且所谓‘足够天赋’，从没有明确标准。
至少，方羽在大专的三年，还从没听说过学校内出现‘直通生’，久而久之，所有学生都默认直通生不存在了。
今天。
自己拿到了直通生名额？
“直通生？”考核中位列保送名单第一的‘张涛’，也不由看向方羽，仿佛想要知道方羽凭什么拿到直通生。
“好。”
“方羽，你们十一人随我来，其余人解散。”女老师直接道，转身向楼上走去，方羽和十名保送生纷纷跟上。
众人很有默契的，十名保送生都跟在了方羽身后。
让方羽排在第一位。
content_en:
;;
"I'm not on the recommendation list, and I'm not on the actual combat assessment list?" Fang Yu was a little confused for a moment.
If it was just that he was not on the recommendation list, Fang Yu could barely accept it. After all, there were only ten places, and he had an inherent disadvantage because he lacked the points of Void Star.
But he didn’t even pass the actual combat assessment? Not normal.
"Wang Mo actually made it to the assessment list?"
"Can that second-generation rich man be on the list? Sure enough, a rich man practices martial arts and rises to the top, but the Fang Yu next to him didn't even pass the actual combat assessment? Has he regressed so much?"
"It seems that he has never awakened to the void star. It is normal that he was not selected. His skills are higher, but he does not have much advantage at our stage."
"That's true."
"Zhang Tao is so awesome, he actually reached the first place." Many assessors were chatting and talking, and the one who attracted the most attention was naturally 'Zhang Tao' who was ranked first on the recommendation list.
Ranking first means that the assessment score is also first.
At this time.
"Quiet." A female teacher wearing a loose martial arts uniform stood up. Her gaze swept across the hall and quickly silenced everyone: "The list has been published and will be publicized for two days. If anyone doubts their results, they can apply for review on the official website before twelve o'clock tomorrow night."
"The 70 students who participated in the actual combat assessment will continue to practice normally in school and be prepared. Details of the actual combat assessment requirements will be sent to your personal email addresses. We will gather on 9.14."
"The 10 recommended students, follow me upstairs now to sign the documents." The female teacher paused at this point, and her eyes fell on Fang Yu: "Student Fang Yu, you have obtained the direct student quota, and you will not occupy the recommended quota. Come with me first, and I will take you to meet some teachers from Huguang Wuhan University later."
Wow~
There was an uproar.
In an instant, almost all the students' eyes were focused on Fang Yu, with shock and disbelief in their eyes.
"Direct student quota? Damn it, Lao Fang, you're so secretive." Wang Mo said excitedly.
Fang Yu was also a little dizzy.
Direct student quota? This was completely beyond his expectation.
There are actually three paths for those who want to advance from junior college to bachelor's degree in martial arts colleges. One is recommended and the other is actual combat assessment and selection. These are the two most common ones.
Fixed time, fixed assessment items, fixed number of admissions.
There is another path, which is ‘direct’.
There is no time and age limit... As long as you show enough talent in martial arts in junior college, you can directly apply for the assessment. If you pass the assessment, you can enter the martial arts undergraduate program. In theory, you can be promoted in your freshman year.
It's just that it's too rare.
And there is never a clear standard for what is considered ‘sufficient talent’.
At least, during the three years that Fang Yu had been in college, he had never heard of a 'direct student' in the school. Over time, all students assumed that direct students no longer existed.
today.
Got a direct student quota?
"Direct student?" 'Zhang Tao', who was ranked first on the recommendation list in the assessment, couldn't help but look at Fang Yu, as if he wanted to know why Fang Yu got the direct student.
"Okay."
"Fang Yu, eleven of you will follow me, and the rest will disperse." The female teacher said directly, turned around and walked upstairs, followed by Fang Yu and the ten recommended students.
Everyone had a tacit understanding, and all ten recommended students followed Fang Yu.
Let Fang Yu be ranked first.
